author: ALM
body:
I was banned for 8 days from the server by "Zac" (Suicide Encouragement.)


While I am not denying the incident happened (however minor it was) I am pointing out that:

1) The guidelines state:

Death threats/suicide encouragement

ServerKick/TempBan1d/TempBan10d/PermBan


2) There were multiple moderators in the channel and even a teamspeak developer, all of them noticed with the TS dev saying "I'll have to punish you" which never happened at the time and the conversation continued.


3) I was never kicked, or banned for a day. The guiltiness exist for a reason and I would LOVE to know the reason why you thought it necessary to skip two tiers of severity and go to an 8 day ban.


Thanks,

See You Soon!

title: ALM's TS Appeal!

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
Howdy there Austin, it's Zac.

While you are allowed to make the argument that this ban is excessive you have also admitted that the incident did happen. Punishments are here to provide a consequence to wrongdoings to drive home the fact that what you did is wrong and to help you learn from the experience. Since the point where you admit to the wrongdoing you don't actually apologize for the wrongdoing which I believe is necessary since it was against another user. It would also show that you do regret these actions. There was also no apology given to the user (at least publicly) immediately after the event. I believe that this, along with the lack of sarcastic "I would LOVE" statements would help you through the appeals process. I will now address your points in the order that you wrote them.

1. These guidelines are not for public use, as you are not a mod you have no right to actually know this information and it is invalid for use in an appeal. Regardless, I will address it since you have seen it. The guidelines are useful tips made for new mods to give them a general idea of what punishments they can hand out for certain wrongdoings. They are at no point set in stone tradeoffs, if they were we would release them publicly for cases like this, so that our users could use them to their advantage not just our developers.

2. This has no relevance to this appeal as you were punished for it, despite the delay. It in no way impacts the validity of this infraction or your responsibility for committing it and is therefore entirely unrelated to the topic which is to try and appeal you.

3a. You were kicked previously.
3b. I do not understand what you are saying when you wrote "The guiltiness exist for a reason". I am assuming what you meant was guidelines, in which case see point 1. as that statement adds no new information or evidence regarding your ban.
3c. The severity of the punishment comes from multiple reasons including but not limited to: recommendations of other staff members, previous punishments for the same reasons and lack of an apology as mentioned in my opening statement. Unless you have new information or an apology to provide, consider this appeal denied.

Thanks,
Zac.

replies.author: ALM
replies.body:
Since, as the last line of your response states: "Unless you have new information or an apology to provide, consider this appeal denied." I am going to UNLOCK and RE-MARK this appeal as I do have more information.

I will now address all of your points.

1. The guidelines are in a forum that the following users can see:

2.3.0 :011 > ranks

 => ["Developer", "Administrator", "Senior Moderator", "Moderator", "Junior Moderator", "Manager", "-All Permissions-"];


While these guidelines are not public, they are still valid guidelines and since I can see them ,I have the right to use them in an appeal.

2. While the delay does not impact the validity of the infraction, it does show that multiple moderators in the channel deemed the incident as not being worth a punishment. 

3a. I beg to differ. Here is a search of all TS logs since April: http://hastebin.com/uwazaronoy.md. You will note that the only two incidents were a kick on the 30th of June with no reason, so there is no way for us to determine what that kick is for, and the ban yesterday.

3b. Ya it was autocorrect xDD.

3c. I see no evidence of previous punishments for the same reason, so that's an invalid reason AND I am not going to apologize for a joke I made to a close friend who obviously was not offended by the matter.


Thanks!

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
I asked Newcleus not to lock it when prompted with the question, but I believe it was too late. Apologies for the lock.

1. You do not have the right to use the guidelines in the appeal, just because you have access to them (which I find regrettable, since you have no reason for using them). I have otherwise addressed them regardless of their validity so trying to use them is pointless. This is not new information as it has already been addressed.

2. This is not new information and while the way that you interpreted it was that the mods saw it as unfit to punish, in which case they would all be reprimanded for letting this go; I saw it as the TeamSpeak Developer who in your own statement said "I'm going to have to punish you" made his intent clear but choose to wait to give the punishment after having consulted others, gathered evidence and generally gotten a better hold the circumstances.

3a. You begging to differ is not new information either. At a very inconvenient time our evidence spreadsheet was recently ruined by anonymous user who also deleted a considerable amount of infractions. Luckily I specifically remember having personally kicked and verbal warned you for the same offense.
3c. You are right there you see no evidence of previous punishments for the same reasons however as that is once again the duty of the appealer and not the hopeful appealed what you see doesn't actually make a difference in your appeals process. This is also not new information as you have stated this before.

Since your appeal is based off of a claim that I did not follow the guidelines which you have no rights to see, nevermind use in an appeal, not to mention the reasons I have given to debunk to the validity of that argument regardless of right to use I will now deny the appeal again. Since you also refuse to apologize for breaking the rules or to the user to whom you encouraged to kill themselves and have not actually presented valid new information I will now lock this thread, do not unlock it again.

Thanks,
Zac
